success_definition: completed episode return > 0; new recordings additionally persist terminal metadata won=true

planner_level1.producer: categorical CEM with the original rollout-h8 ensemble

success_level1_2.producer: planner level-1 demonstrations plus stochastic PPO level-2 rollouts

success_level1_3.producer: level-1/2 success corpus plus stochastic sequential-PPO level-3 rollouts

success_level1_4.producer: level-1/2/3 success corpus plus two stochastic learned-policy level-4 generations

policy_lineage: rollout-h8 ensemble -> categorical CEM level-1 demonstrations
balanced masked behavior cloning -> stochastic level-2 successes
behavior-cloned PPO curriculum -> stochastic level-3 successes
successful replay -> balanced masked behavior cloning
rollout-2048 PPO -> reward-ranked behavior cloning -> stochastic level-4 successes
limitations: These replay corpora are selected training data, not held-out policy evaluation.
Most recorded level-2 through level-4 episodes lose; success counts are intentionally reported separately.
Coverage through level 1-4 does not establish mastery of those levels or playability of all 50 Adventure stages.
Vector-v2 is partially observed and omits projectiles, coin positions, lawn mowers, grid items, and engine RNG state.
